thread:
acme_john: Hey, we're seeing structured JSON responses from the streaming API cut off mid-object. Our parser fails with \"Unexpected end of JSON input\". Happening intermittently for long responses.

maria_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the raw bytes you received (or a curl -v capture)? Also which endpoint and model?

acme_john: Using /v1/generate?mode=json-stream with model=redwood-large. Here's the tail of one stream we captured (we're using node-fetch):

acme_john: ```
data: {"responses":[{"id":"a1","text":"First chunk..."}]}
data: {"responses":[{"id":"a2","text":"Second chunk..."}]}
data: {"responses":[{"id":"a3","text":"Third chunk that gets long and then..."}

// connection closes here abruptly, no closing ] or final event
```

maria_support: Ugh. Looks like final bracket is missing. Are you going through any proxies/load balancers on your side? Any intermediate gateways that might cut long-lived connections?

acme_john: We proxy through our gw that does health checks. We'll try bypassing it. Repro steps we used: `curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?mode=json-stream\" -d @payload.json`

ashwin_eng_runtime: @maria_support looping in runtime — this looks like a chunk boundary/flush problem. Two quick questions: 1) do you see the TCP FIN from client or server side? 2) any 502/504 logs on our edge?

maria_support: No 502/504 in customer logs. They captured tcpdump showing a connection reset from a proxy hop after ~65s.

katie_eng_infra: @ashwin_eng_runtime could be Nginx default proxy_read_timeout + client body buffering. Also some cloud load balancers tear long idle SSEs. Can the customer confirm keepalives and chunked streaming are passing through?

acme_john: We disabled our proxy and hit the Redwood endpoint directly — stream completed fine. So this is reproducible when going via our gateway. When routed direct, final event arrives with closing wrapper.

ashwin_eng_runtime: That strongly points to an intermediate closing connection. Two mitigation ideas: 1) add an explicit final sentinel event like `data: __END__` so clients can detect truncation vs natural end, 2) change server to emit a short keepalive comment every 15s to prevent some LB timeouts. We'll evaluate both.

maria_support: Logged as INC-211112: customer reported JSON tail loss via intermediate proxy. Assigning to ops-triage for infra analysis and to eng-runtime for product mitigations.

ops-triage: We pulled edge logs for the customer's region — no premature FIN on our side. We do see the customer's gateway IP with a SYN-ACK then an immediate RST at ~65s after start. Looks like their LB is the culprit.

acme_john: Confirmed with our infra team: internal gateway kills streams after 60s of perceived inactivity (they didn't treat keepalives as activity). We'll request them to allow longer idle time or pass through TCP keepalives.

katie_eng_infra: For customers that can't change their gateway, eng-runtime will implement a short heartbeat in the stream (a comment SSE line `:hb\n`) every 10s and then emit a final `data: {"_final":true}` event. That should make the stream detectable even if the gateway occasionally drops the tail.

ashwin_eng_runtime: Also adding server-side safety: when streaming structured-array JSON we can optionally buffer the closing bracket and write it inside a final chunk prefixed with an explicit `event: end` SSE event. That reduces the chance of producing orphaned fragments if a mid-hop cut happens, and clients can fallback to a reconstruct-from-prefix behavior.

maria_support: Communicated interim workaround to customer: bypass gateway or increase idle timeout; or enable our SDK quick patch that treats truncated stream as recoverable (attempt re-fetch with range of last known id).

acme_john: We'll try adding keepalives and ask our infra to increase timeouts. Appreciate the quick triage. 

support-bot: Ticket INC-211112 updated. Status: acknowledged -> investigating.

maria_support: Follow-up action items: (1) ops-triage to confirm no edge misbehavior (done), (2) eng-runtime to prototype heartbeat + final end event (assigned to ashwin), (3) provide customer-facing KB with curl repro and SDK fallback pattern.

ashwin_eng_runtime: Prototype plan: add `:hb` every 10s and emit `event: end\ndata: {"complete":true, "closing_bracket":"\"]"}` in final event. Also add server-side doc note for customers about intermediate proxies. Will post PR link once ready.

acme_john: Thanks — if you can also add a small note about how to configure nginx (proxy_read_timeout, proxy_buffers, proxy_buffering off) that'd be super helpful.

katie_eng_infra: Adding Nginx snippet to KB: ```proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 120s; proxy_send_timeout 120s; keepalive_timeout 120s;```

maria_support: Marking thread: needs-customer-followup. I'll circle back after eng runtime PR lands. :thumbsup:

acme_john: Great, we'll confirm once infra changes rolled out on our side. Thanks everyone!
